name: Mingmin Zhao
title: Assistant Professor of Computer and Information Science
department: Computer and Information Science; secondary Electrical and Systems Engineering
researchAreas: Robot perception beyond line of sight
fitReason: A strong CS/perception match with real robot-mounted sensing and a concrete visiting-student inquiry route. Projects emphasize physics-guided neural reconstruction, multimodal sensing and robust spatial representations rather than manipulation or locomotion policy learning.

physicalEvidence.summary: HoloRadar (NeurIPS 2025) evaluates physics-guided learned RF reconstruction on sensor data collected with a joystick-controlled Lynxmotion Wheeled Rover. Section B.2 describes real data acquisition; the runtime section reports RTX 4070 inference and timing compatible with radar scans. Neither section establishes online learned inference on the rover stream. This is robot-collected perception evidence, with autonomous navigation, onboard processing and a live sensor-to-action loop unverified.

shortVisit.summary: The live WAVES contact page explicitly says the group hosts a small number of visiting students and summer interns each year. It invites early email to Mingmin Zhao with a CV, transcript, intended dates and a short description of intended research problems. This visitor section is separate from the Penn-only undergraduate/master’s paragraph. It does not specify an eight-week minimum/maximum, summer 2027 capacity, funding or acceptance.
